verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was to me, “Behold.”
verses.2: And you, son of man, say: “Thus says the Lord God: A season has come upon the land of Israel. This season will come with four wings.”
verses.3: Now, let the rod fall upon you. I will send my breath into you, and you shall be judged according to your ways. I will place all of your burdens upon you.
verses.4: And do not look at my eyes with your eyes. Do not be envious, for your ways lead you astray. Your sorrows will become part of your being. And know that I am Jehovah.
verses.5: So said Adonai Yehovah: There is one bad thing that has happened. Look, it’s already happened.
verses.6: The time has come. The moment has arrived for you. Look, it’s here now.
verses.7: The time has come for the trumpet to sound. The day of judgment has arrived. The mountains will tremble, and they won’t be able to withstand it anymore.
verses.8: Now, from afar, I will pour out my burning passion upon you. I will fill you with my love, and you shall be judged according to my ways. I will place all my sufferings upon you.
verses.9: And do not look at my eyes, nor do I want to follow your ways. Your sorrows will be inside you, and you will know that I am the LORD who loves you.
verses.10: Look, today has come. The flower has bloomed; the sun has risen.
verses.11: The wicked will rise up against those who are not like them, and they will not be like them at all. They will not be among them.
verses.12: The time came when joy would be shared, and sorrow would be avoided. For beauty will be present in all things.
verses.13: For the buyer who sells to the seller, he will not return. They will continue to live their lives as they do now. For those who see all this happen, they will not be able to return either. And no one who is in such a situation will be able to survive.
verses.14: They set it in place, and they prepared everything. But I won’t go to battle, because I am tired of all this fighting.
verses.15: Famine in the fields, and hunger and death in the homes that are in the wilderness. In times of famine, people die; and in cities, hunger and death take their lives.
verses.16: And they fled their homes, and they became like rocks in the mountains, all of them lying there, with no one to protect them.
verses.17: All the hands will be torn apart, and all the blessings will be lost in the sea.
verses.18: And they were bound with chains; their bodies were covered with filth. They were also shaved on all their faces, and their heads were covered with ice.
verses.19: Their money will be thrown away, and their gold will become worthless. They will not be able to save themselves on the day of Jehovah’s judgment. Their souls will not be spared, and nothing will fill their hearts, for they have been destroyed completely.
verses.20: And I placed them in a place where they could be seen by everyone. Their enemies made mistakes in their actions, and so I gave them over to them as a punishment.
verses.21: And they gave him into the hands of the foreigners, so that they could exploit and destroy him.
verses.22: And I turned my face away from them. They destroyed my hopes and dreams. Then, thieves came in and destroyed them as well.
verses.23: Make a altar, for the land is full of bloodshed, and the city is filled with chaos.
verses.24: And I brought forth the daughters of nations, and they inherited their mothers’ lands. I also gave them beautiful gardens and springs from their sacred wells.
verses.25: May they seek peace and tranquility.
verses.26: May the Lord rule over all things. May there be communication between them. And may the words of the prophet be heard, and may the laws be established by the priests. And may the advice of the elders be followed.
verses.27: The king will be sad, and his heart will be filled with sorrow. The hands of the people of the land will become weak. I will judge them according to their deeds, and they will know that I am Jehovah.
